capabilities: render timeline views from timeline code blocks in notes
parse Chinese and ISO date formats, multiple dates, and time-of-day words
display date ranges as progress bars with computed status
reference timelines stored in other notes with a source: directive
archive past events and add new events via command palette
disambiguation: It renders visual timelines from code blocks in notes; it is not a calendar or daily-notes manager.
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English) and includes a full changelog through version 1.7.0; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, though the changelog says it passed community plugin review.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render event timelines from notes, and existing rendering struggles with Chinese date formats.
summary: Timeline renderer that turns ```timeline code blocks into visual timelines, with Chinese-first date parsing, date-range progress bars, and note-summarizing commands.
